comment: Bytes, regression ceilings — tighten only. Set just above the measured values after the ordering pass (engine 60707 min / 18784 gz; was 52259/16345 after M3.5 — the delta is the canonical-order tables and sorted insertion). ~72% of the minified engine is string data (the Tailwind v4 property/keyword vocabulary, packed statics, and now PROP_ORDER/VARIANT_ORDER), leaving ~15KB of actual code. The gz numbers are the network-relevant ones: full stack ~26KB gz vs ~200KB for the UnoCSS stack it replaces.
